data.name: Bite of the Ship
data.description: Once, at half health: Isonade tears off a piece of the hull. From now on it slams faster and its brine lasts longer.
data.battleDescription: %user tears a piece out of the hull. Planks rip inward and vanish into the water.

data.name: Arm Lash
data.description: The arm sweeps every hex around it.
data.battleDescription: The arm lashes across the planks.

data.name: Isonade Undertow
data.description: When nobody is in its reach, the water drags the far side of the room 3 hexes toward Isonade.
data.battleDescription: The water pulls hard toward %user.

effects.description: Redirects the target towards or away from the user by power number of spaces

data.name: Crate Swing
data.description: Swings a looted crate. The same steady hit every time.
data.battleDescription: %user swings a looted crate at %target.

data.name: Cutlass Slash
data.description: A looter's cutlass. The same hard cut every time.
data.battleDescription: %user slashes at %target with a notched cutlass.

data.name: Pocket a Ration
data.description: Once a fight, at half health, he eats a pocketed ration and can't fall this round.
data.battleDescription: %user stuffs a pocketed ration in his mouth. He won't fall this round.

data.name: Hand Out a Ration
data.description: Feeds one looter beside him: it can't fall this round and heals a little.
data.battleDescription: %user hands %target a ration. %target won't fall this round.

data.name: Count Out a Ration
data.description: Alone, he counts out a ration for himself. He eats it next turn.
data.battleDescription: %user counts out a ration for himself. He'll eat it next turn.

data.name: Eat a Ration
data.description: Eats the ration he counted out: he can't fall this round and heals a little.
data.battleDescription: %user eats his ration. He won't fall this round.

data.name: Count the Stores
data.description: A slow, heavy hit. Each count makes the next few hit harder.
data.battleDescription: %user counts the stores out loud and brings the ledger down on %target.

data.name: Stack the Crates
data.description: Stacks looted crates into a wall in front of the crew.
data.battleDescription: %user stacks crates into a wall.
